title: Org chart
description: Reporting lines for one company or organization. Lives at stakeholders/org-charts/org-NNNN.md; the Markdown body holds free-form notes.

schema_version.description: 1.1 when the chart uses units or a member has a title or unit.

organization.description: Company or organization this chart describes.

members.description: Each stakeholder appears once. A member without reports_to is at the top of the chart.

reports_to.description: Stakeholder id of the manager, who must also be a member of this chart.

title.description: Title in this chart. Overrides the stakeholder's role for this organization only.

unit.description: Id of the unit this member belongs to. Membership only; reporting lines come from reports_to.

units.description: Optional departments, teams or other groups in this chart. Units nest through parent; people report to people, never to units.

id.description: Chart-local id; stays the same when the unit is renamed or moved.

parent.description: Id of the unit this one sits in. Absent for a top-level unit.

head.description: Stakeholder id of the person who leads the unit; must be a member of this chart.
